expectations.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
Four stat card elements are present covering active servers, traffic, uptime, and tickets
expectations.evidence: statCards array (lines 11-16) defines four entries: 'Active Servers', 'Monthly Traffic', 'Uptime', and 'Open Tickets', each rendered as a <Card>.

expectations.text: CSS @keyframes or animation property is used for entrance animations
expectations.evidence: Lines 5-9: @keyframes fadeInUp defined in animationStyles; applied via animation property on each stat Card (lines 47-49).

expectations.text: Each stat card has a different animation-delay value to create the stagger effect
expectations.evidence: Line 50: animationDelay: `${i * 100}ms` — produces 0ms, 100ms, 200ms, 300ms for the four cards respectively.

expectations.text: Colors reference CSS custom properties rather than hard-coded hex values (no hard-coded hex anywhere, including status badge styles)
expectations.evidence: No hard-coded hex (#xxxxxx) values found, but numerous Tailwind color utility classes are used throughout: text-gray-900, text-gray-500, bg-gray-50, border-gray-100, text-gray-400, text-gray-800, text-gray-600, hover:bg-blue-50. These bypass the CSS custom property system entirely and resolve to hard-coded color values, violating the CSS variables requirement.

expectations.text: Server list section contains at least 3 rows/items
expectations.evidence: servers array (lines 18-22) contains 3 entries: web-prod-01, db-primary-02, and cache-node-03, each rendered as a row.

expectations.text: Animation durations are in the 200-600ms range
expectations.evidence: Line 47: animation: 'fadeInUp 0.4s ease-out forwards' — duration is 0.4s (400ms), within the 200-600ms range.
